head: d6d284d04b38946e92ca5a10df244a2db487b3b0
issue: V1.4 acceptance P1 follow-up: deadline_sec on a plain sync callable is only a cooperative promise; it must not be presented as a hard timeout
denominator_note: single denominator for all V1.4 docs and evidence; includes test_offline_guard, which re-runs 1084 tests internally
compileall: python3 -m compileall -q src tests -> no output, exit 0

accepted: check_path(binding, action, parameters, state, *, timeout_sec=...) or deadline=...
callable marked hard_bounded = True that declares deadline_sec and forwards it to a hard-timeout transport (KtdPathChecker)
hard_bounded.guarantee: the underlying transport (socket timeout) really stops waiting

cooperative.guarantee: provider promise only; this repository cannot stop a violating call

unbounded.platform_assembly: allowed, but preview/confirm never call it

provider_contract.late_conclusion_rule: clear and blocked beyond the declared budget become timeout/PATH_CHECK_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED; this means the response is not trustworthy, NOT that the call was stopped; local geometry 'invalid' is never reclassified
provider_contract.background_work: none (no threads, no processes, no extra listening sockets, no asyncio cancellation)

timeout_really_stops_waiting.platform_path: yes, via socket timeout min(transport timeout, deadline_sec) passed down to opener.open
timeout_really_stops_waiting.cooperative_provider: no; the process does not interrupt a provider that violates its declared budget
timeout_really_stops_waiting.simulator_fake: no; a cooperative fake only exercises the state machine
timeout_really_stops_waiting.dns: not covered by socket timeout (known residual risk)

platform_assembly.KtdPlatformExecutor: rejects cooperative-only provider at construction; None/unbounded degrade at preview/confirm
platform_assembly.simulator: accepts cooperative fake; every receipt keeps execution_mode=simulator

remaining_limits: real GIS / electronic-fence service never contacted; clear/blocked only come from fake providers
real-network socket timeout not exercised (budget forwarding and exception mapping only)
DNS resolution is not covered by socket timeout
a contract-violating provider is not forcibly interrupted (no threads/processes/asyncio by design)
clear never means the real path is safe and never means the device avoided an obstacle
not_verified: no real GIS or electronic-fence service was contacted
no real platform write or device execution
no real-device obstacle avoidance or path safety verification
no real-network socket timeout was exercised; budget forwarding and exception mapping were verified with an injected opener
no forced interruption of a contract-violating provider (deliberately not implemented)
